definitions.ask: Should the bars choice survive an Obsidian restart on this device?
definitions.why: It is a reading preference, not a temporary hide; forgetting it each restart feels broken

choices.label: Remember it on this device, so every restart opens in the last choice
Keep it for the plugin session only, like Toggle Day stats; restarts open with both bars

definitions.ask: Should the Day Strip glossary strand say its two lanes show together or one at a time?
definitions.corrects: Its contents: five LABEL-value facts, a [[root-parent]] legend with `so far · HH:MM` over the root-parent bar, and a [[pomodoro-theme]] legend over the full-width theme bar that separates it from the badges.
